title: Gathin23/cleanyourtv
why_read: A practical utility for debloating Android TV devices, useful to hobbyists but not technically deep.
analysis: This is a tool that strips bloatware and ads from Android/Google TV devices over Wi-Fi and replaces the home screen with something cleaner, modeled after Apple TV's interface. The high star count suggests strong consumer interest, likely driven by frustration with ad-heavy smart TV interfaces. Technically it's a fairly standard ADB-based debloating and launcher-replacement tool rather than a novel engineering contribution. It's useful and popular but not something that teaches new techniques to engineers.
